[[2016 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] champions |bowl = [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = Sweet Sixteen }} {{2015–16 West Coast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2015–16 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team''' represented [[Gonzaga University]] in the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by head coach [[Mark Few]], who was in his 17th season as head coach. The team played its home games at [[McCarthey Athletic Center]], which had a capacity of 6,000. The Bulldogs (also informally referred to as the Zags) played in their 36th season as a member of the [[West Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 28–8, 15–3 in WCC play to finish in a share for the WCC regular season championship. They defeated [[2015–16 Portland Pilots men's basketball team|Portland]], [[2015–16 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]], and [[2015–16 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]] to be champions of the [[2016 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] and earn the conference's automatic bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. As a #11 seed, they defeated [[2015–16 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]] and [[2015–16 Utah Utes men's basketball team|Utah]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen, where they lost to [[2015–16 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]]. The final AP Poll is the most recent poll in which Gonzaga was unranked until [[2023-24 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|2023–24]], when they were unranked for six weeks. ==Previous season==
